steps.content: [Tuco - Street]

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Korryn, you bastard!! Get back here!!

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Hella, don't go!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Why?! Did you realize that she...
Hella wants to chase after Korryn, but Mira grabs her.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: It's dangerous! A sandstorm is coming...
The wind picks up, stirring up the coarse sand. The sky turns dark as a heavy black mass approaches swiftly in the horizon.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: No biggie! Plenty o' time to send you on your way before the sandstorm hits!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Nonsense! With me here...

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Enough, Hella! Just go! Don't worry about us.
Mira seems to have made her decision and tugs on Hella's sleeve. Her hand is trembling, but her tone is firm.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Korryn is a liar. We trusted the wrong person, but you're different... Forget about us. Without us, you alone can definitely get out before the sandstorm hits.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But you guys have no bullets left! If I leave, you're all dead!

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: That's still better than everyone being trapped here. Leave, now! Time is running out!
Mira's tone is firm, but Hella can still feel her hand trembling uncontrollably.
The sandstorm is approaching, and her pipe is no match for the cannons, let alone the raging Mania within it. Without Korryn's help, she probably won't even be able to stop the desert bandits.
...Then, should she flee alone?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No, I can't leave... gotta use my head and think! That dummy wouldn't give up at a time like this. He'd figure something out... There's gotta be a way...
steps.female_content: No, I can't leave... gotta use my head and think! That dummy wouldn't give up at a time like this. She'd figure something out... There's gotta be a way...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...If he were here, he'd definitely...
steps.female_content: She looks down at the woman fallen at her feet.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: Leave? None of you are leaving! Y'all doomed today!... Ahhh!!
A flying object hits him square in the face. This time, the bandit is knocked over by the shovel Hella threw.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You mean yourselves! Y'all are doomed today!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Who cares about guns, shells or sandstorms... I'm <color=#fb9259>Syndicate's littlest big shot, and the pride of the MBCC!</color> So what if you have cannons? I've seen it all in the Black Ring!
Hella raises her weapon, pointing straight at the enemy.
Everyone has things they can't let go of or battles they can't escape from. She's no longer the little mouse fleeing from gunfire.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: These folks are under my protection! By your own rules in WhiteSands, an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wanna mess with them? You gotta get past me first!
